      • isIncludeCacheEnabled

        public boolean isIncludeCacheEnabled​(javax.servlet.ServletRequest request,
                                     javax.servlet.ServletResponse response)
        returns true if the debug feature is enabled by request and by service configuration (or cache feature debug 'on' in the service configuration) and the cache service is available and it is an 'HTML' request

        This is intentionally enabled when config.enabled() is false but config.debug() is true to allow debugging before switching it on.

        Specified by:
        isIncludeCacheEnabled in interface ComponentCache
